📅 2024-04-02 Airstrike (Vicinity) INC-014
On 2 March, Israeli airstrikes on tents housing IDPs and people gathered in front of Al Emirati field hospital were hit. 11 people were killed, and some 50 others were injured.

Among the fatalities was a nurse and a member of the field hospital’s ambulance crew.
